dossier.purpose: AgentsView is a local-first session archive and viewer for AI coding agents (PRODUCT.md:14-20; README.md:3-4,56-62). A Go daemon (CGO, single binary with an embedded Svelte SPA) discovers native agent session files on disk (Claude Code ~/.claude/projects, Codex ~/.codex/sessions, plus dozens of other agents), parses them into a local SQLite archive with FTS5, and serves a web UI, REST/SSE API, a 32-command CLI and a read-only MCP server for browsing, search, token/cost reports, activity reports and heuristic session-health scoring. Usage and cost are derived from token fields the agents write into their own transcripts (internal/parser/claude.go:2715-2723; internal/parser/codex.go:544-560) and priced from LiteLLM / OpenRouter / genai-prices catalogs with an embedded fallback. Optional read-only mirrors: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DuckDB (SQLite stays the archive). Optional features call external OpenAI-compatible endpoints (embeddings, generated insights, Recall extraction). Facts relevant to the stated needs, from the code: (1) OTLP collector / privacy filter: none - there is no OTLP receiver (no 4317/4318 listener, no /v1/metrics|logs|traces route; openapi.yaml:7389-22583 lists only /api/v1 routes); OTLP appears only in a parser for Visual Studio Copilot OpenTelemetry-JSONL trace files read from disk (internal/parser/visualstudio_copilot.go:56-64) and as indirect Go modules (go.mod:164-191). Its own privacy controls are a storage policy archive_content = full|transcripts|usage (docs/configuration.md:50-91), result_content_blocked_categories (docs/data.md:118), and a best-effort secret scanner with default redaction (internal/secrets/secrets.go:1-5; docs/commands.md:1605-1625). (2) Store for OTLP usage metrics: none; usage is stored in its own SQLite usage_events table (internal/db/schema.sql:262). (3) Store for OTLP events/logs: none; its SQLite holds messages, tool_calls, tool_result_events (internal/db/schema.sql:116,315,357). (4) Dashboards: its own embedded web UI over its own SQLite archive (and the read-only PG/ClickHouse/DuckDB mirrors), not over OTLP stores. (5) Traces/datasets/experiments for replaying a fixed workload: none; closest features are the Recall query-event ledger (internal/db/schema.sql:630-650), a build-tag-only lab endpoint excluded from the default binary (internal/server/recall_eval_ingest.go:1-45) and one-shot `capture run` usage results (docs/one-shot-capture.md:8-16). (6) Local model server: none; it is only a client of OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with Ollama and llama.cpp llama-server named as possible endpoints (docs/semantic-search.md:9,271-296,328-362); no GPU / CUDA / RTX 4090 handling.

claims.claim: Browse, search, and track costs across your AI coding agents. Your session archive stays on your machine unless you choose a feature that shares it.

On first run, agentsview discovers sessions from every supported agent on your machine, syncs them into a local SQLite database, and serves a web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8080. The daemon is the server: web UI, API, session sync, and file watchers share one process.
Supported agents table lists Claude Code (~/.claude/projects/) and Codex (~/.codex/sessions/) among dozens of agent session directories; sessions are read from agent-written files.
`agentsview usage` tracks token consumption and compute costs across all coding agents; reports read from the same local SQLite archive that powers the UI.
Automatic pricing via LiteLLM and OpenRouter rates (with offline fallback).

Usage 'Works standalone -- no server required, just run the command', while another passage says commands such as sync, usage, token-use, pg push, duckdb push and clickhouse push auto-start the daemon; a one-shot sync with no background server needs the daemon stopped and AGENTSVIEW_NO_DAEMON=1.
`agentsview capture run` handles one exact non-interactive `claude -p` or `codex exec --json` execution in CI, writes a separate versioned usage result, and starts no daemon, web server, or watcher.
Semantic search is opt-in and indexes session content with any OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.

DuckDB is a mirror backend, not a replacement for SQLite; backend modes: SQLite primary local archive, PostgreSQL / ClickHouse optional remote backends pushed from SQLite and served read-only, DuckDB optional mirror file or Quack endpoint.

agentsview sends a limited anonymous `daemon_active` ping to PostHog when the server starts and every 24 hours (stable random install ID as DistinctId; application, version, commit, OS, CPU arch; $process_person_profile=false, $geoip_disable=true; no session/project/prompt/path/account/machine identity). Disable with AGENTSVIEW_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 or TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0; hard-disabled in Go test binaries.
All session data stays on your machine. The server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default. The update check is optional and can be disabled with --no-update-check.
agentsview binds to loopback and validates the request Host header to guard against DNS-rebinding attacks.
The container runs as root, so prefer a named volume for /data; compose example publishes the UI on 127.0.0.1 only and mounts Claude, Codex, Forge and OpenCode session roots read-only.

install.command: docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -v agentsview-data:/data -v "$HOME/.claude/projects:/agents/claude:ro" -v "$HOME/.forge:/agents/forge:ro" -e CLAUDE_PROJECTS_DIR=/agents/claude -e FORGE_DIR=/agents/forge ghcr.io/kenn-io/agentsview:latest

readme.telemetry_and_network: No account or login is required and no network service is required to run: pricing falls back to an embedded snapshot (docs/token-usage.md:344-346; internal/pricingrefresh/refresh.go:63-124); PRODUCT.md:19-20 states success means no external account. Default-on outbound traffic found in code: (a) PostHog `daemon_active` ping on server start and every 24 h (cmd/agentsview/main.go:45,275-284,615,1309-1332; internal/telemetry/telemetry.go:13-20,108-126); opt-out via AGENTSVIEW_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 or generic TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 (internal/telemetry/telemetry.go:34-36; internal/telemetry/telemetry_test.go:13-44); disabled under Go tests (telemetry.go:39,71,97-99). The PostHog API key is embedded (telemetry.go:16); the reporter, endpoint host and the kit_posthog_disabled build tag live in external module go.kenn.io/kit/telemetry (go.mod:36), not in the working directory; the repo's e2e builds use -tags fts5,kit_posthog_disabled (.github/workflows/ci.yml:742-745; docs/agents/build.md:34-36). A random installation ID is written to ~/.agentsview/telemetry-install-id even when telemetry is disabled (docs/configuration.md:138-141). (b) Pricing refresh: the daemon starts a pricing-refresh job at startup and every 24 h (+5 min jitter) with no config/env off-switch found (cmd/agentsview/main.go:480-489; cmd/agentsview/pricing_schedule.go:12-36; no offline setting in internal/config); it fetches raw.githubusercontent.com (BerriAI/litellm and pydantic/genai-prices) and openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (internal/pricing/openrouter.go:48-55; internal/pricing/catalog/litellm.go:23-27; internal/pricing/catalog/genai.go:22; internal/pricing/catalog/openrouter.go:17); `--offline` exists only on usage / token-use / activity CLI commands (cmd/agentsview/cli.go:588,608,666). (c) Update check: the web UI calls /api/v1/update/check (frontend/src/lib/stores/sync.svelte.ts:218), which contacts github.com/kenn-io/agentsview/releases/latest unless disabled by disable_update_check, --no-update-check or AGENTSVIEW_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK (internal/server/huma_routes_metadata.go:184-197; internal/update/update.go:25-35,80-119; internal/config/config.go:784,2137,2232); `agentsview update` downloads release tarballs (cmd/agentsview/update.go:33-100); the desktop app uses the Tauri updater (docs/configuration.md:1696-1697). (d) Browser-side: the SPA index.html loads Google Fonts (frontend/index.html:7-12), allowed by the CSP (internal/server/server.go:895-896); CSP connect-src is deliberately widened to any http/https/ws/wss origin (internal/server/server.go:859-869). Opt-in egress that can carry session content: PostgreSQL/ClickHouse push, DuckDB Quack, hosted raw sync, SSH/HTTP remote sync, S3 sources, GitHub Gist publish, Cursor Admin API import, the [vector.embeddings] endpoint, the [insights] endpoint and the [recall.extract] endpoint (docs/configuration.md:1677-1689; docs/hosted-raw-sync.md:6-24; docs/token-usage.md:54-98; docs/semantic-search.md:25-62; docs/recall.md:55-82,159-214); insights/extraction endpoints must be HTTPS unless loopback or allow_http, and redirects are refused (internal/config/recall.go:351-376; internal/recall/extract/client.go:115-131; internal/insight/endpoint.go:47-109). Local listeners: HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:8080 by default (internal/config/config.go:1173-1174; internal/server/server.go:1223-1241) with Host-header allowlist, CSP and X-Frame-Options (internal/server/server.go:830-846,997-1020); optional loopback MCP HTTP (internal/mcp/server.go:157-170); no OTLP listener exists. Documentation lag: SECURITY.md:85-115 never mentions PostHog, the OpenRouter / genai-prices fetches or Google Fonts, and docs/configuration.md:1691-1698 lists only update checks and the ping as automatic outbound requests.

code.architecture: Single Go binary (cmd/agentsview) with the Svelte SPA (frontend/) embedded via internal/web, optionally wrapped by a Tauri desktop app (desktop/). Data flow: internal/parser (per-agent discovery and parsers; Registry in types.go:151, Claude in claude.go, Codex in codex.go) -> internal/sync (engine, fsnotify / macOS FSEvents watchers in internal/fsevents, periodic reconcile, S3 and remote sources via internal/remotesync and internal/ssh) -> internal/db (SQLite via mattn/go-sqlite3 with FTS5; schema internal/db/schema.sql: sessions, messages, tool_calls, tool_result_events, usage_events, secret_findings, model_pricing, recall_*) -> internal/service (shared operation layer) -> internal/server (Huma/OpenAPI REST + SSE, auth, CORS, CSP, Host check), CLI commands in cmd/agentsview and internal/mcp. Optional read-only mirrors: internal/postgres (pgx, pgvector), internal/clickhouse (tables incl. sessions, messages, usage_events: schema.go:142-457), internal/duckdb (+Quack), contracts in internal/storage and internal/backendcontract. Pricing: internal/pricing with catalog/ fetchers and embedded snapshots, refreshed by internal/pricingrefresh. Optional model clients: internal/vector (embeddings client + sqlite-vec via go.kenn.io/kit/vector), internal/recall and recall/extract (OpenAI-compatible chat with json_schema), internal/insight (agent CLIs or OpenAI-compatible chat). Privacy/safety: internal/secrets, archive_content policy (internal/config/config.go:670-710). Other: internal/capture, internal/skills, internal/telemetry (PostHog via go.kenn.io/kit/telemetry), internal/update (self-update), internal/artifact and internal/raw* (artifact exchange, hosted raw sync), internal/signals (session health). Daemon lifecycle and listeners use go.kenn.io/kit/daemon (internal/server/server.go:37,1229).

No OTLP receiver exists: OTLP is only parsed from Visual Studio Copilot trace files on disk (internal/parser/visualstudio_copilot.go:56-64; docs/internal/visual-studio-copilot-traces.md:3-8) and OTel modules are indirect dependencies (go.mod:164-191); openapi.yaml:7389-22583 has only /api/v1 routes.

claim_checks.claim: `capture run` starts no daemon, web server, or watcher (README.md:265-269).
claim_checks.evidence: The command loads only a bounded capture config and calls capture.Run, with no daemon/transport resolution (cmd/agentsview/capture.go:41-77; docs/one-shot-capture.md:36-37). A Linux test asserts no new TCP or Unix listening socket during a run (internal/capture/capture_no_socket_linux_test.go:18-62); that socket test is Linux-only.

claim_checks.claim: Semantic search is opt-in and works with any OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (README.md:313-317).
claim_checks.evidence: Disabled by default and enabled via [vector] (docs/semantic-search.md:25-30); the encoder appends /embeddings to a configured base URL and posts an OpenAI-style body (internal/vector/encoder.go:31,375-377; docs/semantic-search.md:293-296). Ollama-specific recovery requires an Ollama /v1 endpoint (internal/vector/encoder.go:392-402). Insights and Recall extraction also use OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoints when configured (internal/insight/endpoint.go:47-109; internal/recall/extract/client.go:382-408).

claim_checks.claim: Binds to loopback and validates the Host header against DNS rebinding (README.md:95-97,756-757).
claim_checks.evidence: Defaults Host 127.0.0.1 and Port 8080 (internal/config/config.go:1173-1174; flags at 2183-2184); the listener binds cfg.Host:cfg.Port (internal/server/server.go:1223-1241); hostCheckMiddleware rejects unrecognised Host values (internal/server/server.go:997-1020); CSP and X-Frame-Options set on non-API responses (internal/server/server.go:830-846).

claim_checks.claim: The update check is optional and can be disabled with --no-update-check (README.md:757-758).
claim_checks.evidence: The /api/v1/update/check handler returns early when DisableUpdateCheck is set (internal/server/huma_routes_metadata.go:184-192); settable by flag, env and config (internal/config/config.go:784,2137,2232,2367-2368). The request is made when the web UI calls the endpoint (frontend/src/lib/stores/sync.svelte.ts:218), not by the daemon at startup as SECURITY.md:113-115 says; the explicit `agentsview update` command always checks (cmd/agentsview/update.go:39).

claim_checks.claim: SQLite stays the archive; PostgreSQL, ClickHouse and DuckDB are optional read-only mirrors pushed from SQLite (README.md:702-707,724-730).
claim_checks.evidence: Storage rule: SQLite is the persistent archive (docs/agents/storage.md:6-9). ClickHouse mirror tables copy the archive's own entities - sessions, messages, usage_events, tool_calls, secret_findings, model_pricing (internal/clickhouse/schema.go:142-457) - and docs state it is a remote copy (docs/clickhouse-sync.md:6-13). DuckDB and pgx drivers are direct dependencies (go.mod:13,19). None of these mirrors ingests OTLP data.

risks: Scope vs OTLP-style observation: the code has no OTLP/OpenTelemetry receiver, no metrics/log/trace store, no dataset/experiment/replay store and no model server; ingestion is file-based session parsing (internal/parser/types.go:151-198), OTLP appears only in a Visual Studio Copilot trace-file parser and as indirect Go modules (internal/parser/visualstudio_copilot.go:56-64; go.mod:164-191), and the OpenAPI surface has no OTLP routes (openapi.yaml:7389-22583). Usage coverage depends on what each agent writes to its transcripts and is described as 'opportunistic' (docs/token-usage.md:38-43). Local model use is only as a client of OpenAI-compatible endpoints with no GPU handling (docs/semantic-search.md:9; docs/recall.md:55-82).

Network/privacy: default-on outbound traffic beyond what README lists - PostHog daemon_active ping (opt-out; reporter code is in external module go.kenn.io/kit/telemetry and not auditable in this checkout), a daemon pricing refresh every 24 h from raw.githubusercontent.com and openrouter.ai with no daemon-level off-switch found (cmd/agentsview/main.go:484-485; cmd/agentsview/pricing_schedule.go:12-36), and browser requests to Google Fonts when the UI is opened (frontend/index.html:7-12). SECURITY.md:85-115 never mentions PostHog, OpenRouter, genai-prices or the fonts, and docs/configuration.md:1691-1698 lists only update checks and the ping.

Sensitive local data: the archive stores full transcripts, tool inputs/outputs and any pasted secrets in plaintext SQLite by default (archive_content defaults to full: internal/config/config.go:1176; SECURITY.md:69-78), with no encryption at rest. The transcripts/usage policies are storage policies, not redaction guarantees (docs/configuration.md:84-91) and the secret scanner is best-effort (SECURITY.md:133-145). When enabled, transcript-derived content is sent to the configured embeddings, insights and Recall-extraction endpoints (docs/recall.md:73-77,201-207; docs/semantic-search.md:69-79).

Security policy: SECURITY.md has no working private reporting contact - the Reporting section is a TODO placeholder (SECURITY.md:162-170); it calls itself a descriptive foundational document (SECURITY.md:5-9); the threat model excludes hostile same-user processes and multi-user hosts (SECURITY.md:39-53); CSP connect-src is deliberately widened as an accepted tradeoff (internal/server/server.go:859-869; SECURITY.md:127-130).

Release and supply chain: the workflow that builds and publishes release tarballs, SHA256SUMS, the GHCR image, the Homebrew cask and PyPI wheels is not in this checkout's .github/workflows; integrity checking is SHA-256 from the same GitHub release with no signature or attestation (scripts/install.sh:78-112; internal/update/update.go:137-140,214-231); the desktop updater config carries pubkey 'NOT_SET' and an endpoint under github.com/wesm/agentsview (desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:56-61); the Docker image runs as root (README.md:131-135; Dockerfile:54-69).

Build and dependency: building from source needs CGO, Go 1.27 and Node 24.11+ (go.mod:3; README.md:774), network access to fetch a pinned pricing snapshot from GitHub (Makefile:58-61; internal/pricing/cmd/litellm-snapshot/main.go:41-48), a pseudo-version of first-party go.kenn.io/kit (go.mod:36) and a git-commit-pinned @kenn-io/kit-ui (frontend/package.json:21); 159 indirect Go modules (go.mod:49-209). Renovate enables only github-actions, gomod and npm, so Cargo and Python manifests are not covered (renovate.json:5).

Maintenance pace and maturity: frequent releases (0.41.0 on 2026-08-16, 0.41.1 on 2026-08-18, 0.42.0 on 2026-09-01, 0.43.0 on 2026-09-14: docs/changelog.md:42,358,487,514); Recall is marked experimental and may need corpus rebuilds on upgrade (docs/recall.md:11-17); token-usage reporting is marked experimental (docs/token-usage.md:18-24); docs lag the tag - at the v0.44.0 commit the changelog still names 0.43.0 as latest and lists ClickHouse sync under Unreleased (docs/changelog.md:6-17); benchmark gates were removed from CI (docs/internal/performance-gates.md:4,97) and published timings are first-party local observations (docs/internal/performance-investigation.md:3-6,121-129).

Licensing: the project is MIT, copyright Kenn Software LLC (LICENSE:1-3). No NOTICE or third-party license inventory file was found in the checkout, and dependency licenses (DuckDB bindings, ClickHouse and AWS SDKs, the SQLite amalgamation via mattn/go-sqlite3: go.mod:7,13,23,58-75) were not audited here; the optional CJK sidecar ships its own license files (Makefile:99-130).
